text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho—a race given
extra weight
by the heavy plaque the
racers compete over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fshhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Seriously?! Rain?! On top of all this?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even the weather this year is heavy.
More and
more things start to weigh on
Mejiro Palmer's
mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(The autumn Tenno Sho... The Mejiro
family holds
this race in huge esteem,
just like the one in the
spring...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (The track is a mud pit... I'm so not in the mood for a party where they serve nothing but mud pies...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Owww... My shoulders are stiff and my
legs are,
like, throbbing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Helios looks pretty wiped from training
for
medium-distance races. Her smile
looks super
forced...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So you've come, Teio. Shall we move on
to the
second act?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's. But this time, I'm taking all the
lines. I'll be
the lead and you'll be the
one left standing there,
speechless!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(And as for our other opponents...
They're star
players born with the weight
of their destinies
already on their backs!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Can we really get lit in the middle of all
that? Can
we laugh? Can we run?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Can we put our whole hearts into this
party?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course we can! Who do you think we
are?! We
dance to our own beat, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm the black sheep of the Mejiro family,
Mejiro
Palmer! And my bestie and I are
'bout to hit the
track so hard, you'll feel
it in your souls!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Really, Palmer?! You're going to do that here?! This is not the kind of place for this behavior...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I like it! She looks like she's having
fun! I can
get behind that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, bestie! ☆ Prepare to be shooketh,
'cause I
just got a wild idea!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this race all about us today.
Whaddya
think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Make this race... all about us?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I mean, it's all cloudy and no one
else
seems to be feelin' it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So let's come hot out the gate and drop
jaws with
a neck-and-neck showdown!
You and me! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So? Wanna show off? Let's have us a

Helios-Palmer Love Match! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A love match between just you and me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's do it! Let's pump up the
vibes to
eleven here on the track, you
and me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Watch out, everyone, 'cause we're about
to light
it up! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer puts her whole heart and
soul on
display for the audience to see,
the way she
wasn't able to do back at
the Spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I did it! I really did it! I'm over the
biggest hurdle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Let's go show everyone how
our
friendship wins over everything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their free-spirited roar pierces the rain
clouds.
Mejiro Palmer and her bestie,
Daitaku Helios,
dance together in the
Fuchu rain.
